verdict.line: You lose if you let him sit in Cannon stance and chip you down with Shock Blast through an Acceleration Gate from range; you win almost every fight you turn into a stand-and-swing melee check, which is exactly what Illaoi vs Jayce measures at 51.6% over 978 games.

brief.thesis: Jayce is two champions in one lane: a kiting Cannon-stance poke threat and a melee Hammer-stance brawler, and Illaoi only cares about the second one. Her E (Test of Spirit) and W (Harsh Lesson) exist specifically to drag a melee target into an extended trade, so every time Jayce swaps to Hammer stance to engage, he's walking into the one form of this matchup where Illaoi has lane and solo-kill advantage.

theirWindow.when: Cannon stance with E (Acceleration Gate) placed
theirWindow.what: Back off the wave and farm from max range — a Shock Blast fired through his own Acceleration Gate gets boosted missile speed, range, and damage, so don't stand in the lane center while that gate is down.

yourWindow.when: Jayce leaps in with Hammer-stance Q (To the Skies!)
yourWindow.what: He's now stuck in melee range next to you. Immediately E (Test of Spirit) him — the spirit echoes damage back onto him and starts the clock toward turning him into a Vessel that feeds your tentacles.

powerCurve.note: Neither spike hits yet, trades are even
Boots and poke items widen his kite window
R (Leap of Faith) turns skirmishes into your all-in
Iceborn/Cleaver online, you win extended fights

start.why: Sustains you through his early poke while you wait to force him into Hammer-stance range; it's the higher-pick, higher-winrate start into this matchup (49.3% over 611 games).

boots.why: Cuts down the auto-attack harassment he leans on in Cannon stance before you can close distance — the measured higher-winrate boots choice (51.6% over 827 games).

core.why: Gives you the extra burst and slow-on-proc you need to actually stick to him once you've closed the gap with W.
Shred stacks make every tentacle hit and W trade do more once you're in melee range, which is where your win rate lives.
The tankiness buys you the extra half-second of melee contact his knockback and slows are trying to deny you.

situational.when: the enemy team is stacking magic damage alongside Jayce's kit
you're diving onto a fed carry and need the bleed-healing cushion to survive the return burst
you want more lane-phase burst and on-hit sustain instead of pure bruiser stats

runes.keystoneWhy: Every proc heals you back through his poke trades and Demolish punishes him hard if he ever stands still in melee to brawl.

summoners.why: This is the measured high point for the matchup (54.5% win rate, 35.3% pick) — Exhaust directly neutralizes his Hammer-stance all-in damage and his Cannon-stance attack-speed burst, the two tools he actually threatens you with.

playing.title: Farm from tentacle range
playing.detail: Pull and last-hit from behind your passive's tentacles near terrain so his Cannon-stance poke has to go through them first, exactly as the matchup data recommends.

playing.title: Punish his Q engage with E
playing.detail: The instant he leaps in with Hammer-stance Q (To the Skies!), fire E (Test of Spirit, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) — he's melee-locked and the spirit echo starts punishing him immediately.

playing.title: Watch for the stance-swap speed burst
playing.detail: His passive (Hextech Capacitor) grants move speed on every weapon swap — that burst of speed is your tell that he just reloaded either poke or an engage tool.

playing.title: Spam W to stay stuck to him
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson is only a 4s cooldown 400-range leap — use it liberally once he's in range so your tentacles keep swinging on him instead of letting him reset to Cannon stance and kite.

playing.title: Herd him toward walls
playing.detail: Your passive spawns tentacles only on impassable terrain, so fight near jungle entrances and walls, not lane center, to maximize how many tentacles are swinging during the trade.

playing.title: Don't walk into a loaded Acceleration Gate
playing.detail: If his E (Acceleration Gate) is down in Cannon stance, a Shock Blast through it gets extra range, speed, and damage — route around it rather than farming through the middle of it.

playing.title: Save R for a guaranteed stick
playing.detail: Leap of Faith is 120/95/70/70/70s on cooldown and spawns a tentacle per champion hit — only commit it when he's already melee-locked by your W or E, not as a poke-trade panic button.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, runes, summoner spells, and every win-rate/sample number above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and trade calls are my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Pull and farm lane in order to prevent being poked at, while keeping his (E)-(Q) in check by positioning yourself properly. When Jayce closes in with (Q), counterplay by using [E] immediately and deal damage. Although it is difficult to deal with ranged attacks, keep in mind that Illaoi is stronger in melee fights.
